note: Room rules change when things happen in a combat room, never how hard they hit, and never touch robot art. A mission room opts in with "rule": {"type": "<ID>", "seconds": n} on its row (next to "encounter" and "hazards"); a room without the key behaves exactly as before. Boss rooms and the training simulator take no rule, and a rule that needs a reinforcement wave is refused on a room that has none (scripts/combat/room_rule.gd RoomRule.problems; the quick test room_rule reads every mission file).

OVERRUN.tip: OVERRUN: the next wave comes on a timer, whether or not this one is thinned out. Its entry points are marked first.
